preconditions.description: Number of students is between 1 and 1000.
Number of buses is between 1 and 10^9.
Number of days is between 1 and 1000.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' if k < n else True
postconditions.description: If the number of buses is less than the number of students, output '-1'. Otherwise, output a valid arrangement.
The output contains exactly d lines.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == n for line in return_value.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each line contains exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= k for line in return_value.splitlines() for x in line.split())
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output is between 1 and k.

postconditions.expression: all(any(int(x) != int(y) for x in lines[i].split() for y in lines[j].split()) for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1, n))
postconditions.description: No two students are in the same bus for all d days.
